dedupe_keys.name: pgaeid projected global area equipped for irrigation 2020 2100 under ssp scenarios

description: PGAEID projects the area equipped for irrigation on a 5 arc-minute global grid for every decade from 2020 to 2100 under five Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSP1 to SSP5). National totals come from an ensemble of six machine learning models trained on FAO AQUASTAT irrigation records from 1961 to 2015 (reported Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency 0.98), and are downscaled from the 2005 FAO baseline and the GMIA 2005 map using scenario-specific annual change rates. Researchers at Beijing Normal University published it on Zenodo (version 3.0, May 2025) as one compressed archive of about 97 MB, available as a free download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is global. Caveats: projections extrapolate national trends, and the spatial pattern is anchored to the 2005 baseline maps. Simulation uses: future irrigation infrastructure extent for water demand, capacity planning and climate adaptation scenarios. Related records: the FAO Global Map of Irrigation Areas (data-fao-global-map-of-irrigation-areas) and GMIA-Next (data-gmia-next-global-irrigated-areas-30m).
